summary: Taoping Inc., a Tianjin-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026 to provide unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, plus a related operating and financial review and press release, incorporating them by reference into its Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic financial-reporting update. What to watch: the going-concern disclosure and any subsequent special-situation developments.
